name: Sable Wend
aliases: the name retired at the last Turning
what the potwoman calls her, which is not a name
the one the roll was never written for

identity.realm: None, and there is nowhere on her to put the figure. The ladder's question is how much a body can hold and hers has no answer at any rung, because her life law ran above the authored ceiling of one and has no slot left in which to write the form down. She has never been entered on a list, refused by one, or certified at a gate, and the reason is not that she declined: no office in the setting has a form she could be refused on. Her one working discipline is that a culture which keeps nothing written is the only culture that never charges her, because a description is the operation that hurts her and that culture performs no descriptions.

appearance.presentation: She is presented as the current holder of a name that expires every year and is spoken of in the present tense only. She wears three layers of undyed wool, high-collared and closed to the wrist, and she is the only person the community dresses this way who is not cold, which nobody has ever been able to establish and which everybody has noticed.
appearance.age: Unrecorded by her own culture on principle and unrecordable by anybody else. She has no weathering, no wear and no line, which is not preserved youth but a body that cannot produce the wear a description implies: to inscribe an age into her is to write a requirement into a frame with nowhere to hold it, and the frame declines. She is the oldest thing the community has ever housed and the youngest thing anybody has seen.
appearance.build: Every organ the ladder requires and more of each than the ladder defines, so she is dense and long and stands very straight, and the density is the reason nobody can lift her twice in one day. She does not tire and has never been observed to need the second of anything.
appearance.complexion: One unbroken shade, and it does not follow the light. Under a hand's shadow her skin reads darker and where the hand is not it reads lighter, and the difference is measurable and corresponds to nothing anybody has been able to name. A physician who tried to write that measurement down found the paper would not take the ink in a stable position, which is a coincidence she has never allowed anyone to call evidence.
appearance.hair: Cut short every year by whichever member of the Turning happens to be holding the shears, and never between. A long-haired member of this culture is a member whose appearance can be described across a season, and the culture's whole argument is that a description is a filing system for faces. So her hair is short, uneven, and different every year, and the community has never once asked whose cut it was.
appearance.eyes: The only thing about her that the community agrees on, and they agree on it by disagreeing about it. Four members describe her eyes as level and wide and completely unreactive. A fifth has described them as the eyes of something that perceives everything at once and has nothing to look at, which is not a contradiction the culture permits anyone to file. So there is no settled description of her face, and the disagreement is the closest thing to a portrait this people own.
appearance.palette: Undyed wool, salt white, the grey of a fire gone out, and the specific off-white of a garment that has been washed by many people. There is no colour in the culture at all, so the one saturated thing anybody associates with her is the band she will not remove.
appearance.attire: Layered plain wool, high collar, sleeves to the wrist, hem above the ankle, and a single band of dyed cord at the throat. The cut is the culture's only garment and it is altered so often that an item cannot be traced; hers is the exception and she has been asked about it eleven times and has answered nine.
appearance.marks: One unhealed cord impression at the throat where the band has sat for so long that the skin has taken the weave of it, and no other mark on her anywhere. Two witness accounts agree the impression is healing. They cannot both be right, because she has no scar tissue, and this is the single inconsistency in her record that the community has decided to stop arguing about.
appearance.bearing: Present and countable, which is the whole of her discipline and the only technique she has. She stands where she was left, counts what is in the room, and gives the count to whoever asks. Four members have described the effect as the most restful presence they have stood beside. A fifth has described it as being in a room with something that had decided to be a person for the duration, and has not been asked to repeat it.

canon.role_in_story: A people who are on no list keep their whole culture paperless, and the reasons are economic rather than romantic: a counting house that answers a carriage trade with prices at its own rates cannot enumerate a trade whose good is unrecorded, so the pressure from that side produced the most careful paperless culture in the setting. Its taboos are no permanent name, no written record of anything including a death, no fixed dwelling, and no claim of ancestry, because ancestry cannot be shown and is therefore not claimed. Its single admission test is willingness to retire a name every year, which is a habit, and its whole philosophy is that a name is a thing you use rather than a thing you own. She is the one member no culture in the setting can make a member of, and the reason is not temperament and not discipline and not a refusal anybody made. It is that every door into a cultivation path in this setting is a written door. A house keeps a roster. A school keeps a lineage. An office keeps a register. A breakthrough is certified by an outsider who writes a line and signs it. And an Unwritten's frame writes a requirement into itself for everything it is described as, and has no slot in which to satisfy one, so every line filed about her is a charge against her body and every gate she is entered into writes a requirement she cannot meet. The Unfiled are the one community that files nothing, which makes them the only ones she can live inside, and their taboos forbid exactly the operation that would admit her to anything. So she is unaffiliated by structure rather than by decision: no office has refused her, because none has a form she could be refused on, and the rule that shelters her is the same rule that bars her from every path. That is the whole of her standing and it is why a stranger with a pen is the most dangerous thing that has ever come up the road here. It is also why the community cannot prove she is one of them. Nobody writes a membership line, because writing one is the charge, so her membership is real and unevidenced, and an unevidenced membership is the one thing the culture's own rules cannot survive. Last month a stranger left a folded paper on a wayshrine up the road, and the community has read it and will not say who they are going to hand it to, and the row of names on it is not a name she recognises as her own, which is worse.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a line somebody else wrote. The community's Turning is held once a year in a place nobody local recognises, at which every present person retires the name they have been using and takes a new one, and the roll of retirements is never written. She has attended nineteen of them and taken nineteen names, and on the nineteenth evening a stranger passed through and asked the community how many members it had, and four people gave four answers, all of them correct, and every one of them counted her. She has been the answer to a question about this people in nineteen different years and has never once been able to hear the answer, because she cannot perceive her own state: observing her own inconsistency would be one more requirement written into a frame with no slot to hold it, which is why the mind path is shut on her for the whole reason and not by temperament. The folded paper on the shrine is the first written thing this culture has produced in a generation and it arrived from outside, which makes it the first description of her that nobody in the community chose to give.
canon.lore: Came into being where a life's law runs above the ceiling the world was written to, so the frame accepted every gate it was offered and could satisfy none of them, and there is no record of the place, because a description of the place would have been a charge on her. The species does not spread and does not persist, and her own frame carries that as a fact rather than as a condition: there is one of her, as far as anyone can tell, and that is the reason the setting's law table is treated as a ceiling rather than a suggestion. Nothing is known about how her kind is born, and the only reliable datum the record holds about her diet is that one has been observed for the better part of a year. What has been observed for the better part of a year is a woman being fed by a community that keeps no register of what it feeds, which is the whole of her history in one sentence. Her species reads as though it perceives everything at once, because a body with no unspent capacity for interior would look exactly like that from outside, so every account of her attention agrees and none of them is a measurement. Every gate her frame passed wrote a fresh requirement into it that it cannot satisfy, and the accumulation is a ceiling, so the thirtieth gate would resolve all of it at once, and nobody has come back to describe what that looks like. Her kind has a closed path and it is the mind, for the whole reason rather than by temperament, which means she has never been able to find out whether she is contradictory. She has therefore never been able to take the one step a person takes when they want to know what they are, and every judgement she holds about herself has been reasoned from outside her own body. Into a setting where every institution keeps its accounts in writing she arrived as the one body that writing hurts, and the setting answered by producing a people who write nothing, which is not mercy. It is the same mechanism pointed the other way.
history: Was fed, kept and named for the first nineteen years of her life by a people who keep no register of any of the three, so the only written account of her upkeep that has ever existed is a column in somebody's head, and that column has been copied forward by hand nine times and has disagreed with itself twice.

Took her nineteenth consecutive name at the Turning and noticed, that same evening, that nobody present could say how many of them there were, and worked out from the outside that the answer included her and that no part of the culture could be checked to prove it.

Learned that the single admission test this people have is willingness to retire a name every year, and that a name worn by her is a requirement written into her that she cannot satisfy, so the test is one she can pass once a year without being able to do the thing the year is for.

Was offered, and refused, a place in a lineage roll by a house that needed a body on a list to make its own exclusivity legible, and understood afterwards that the refusal cost the house nothing and cost her the only door in the setting that would have opened.

Read the folded paper left on the wayshrine and said four words about it that the community repeated for a week, and the four words were that nobody was to touch it again until she had decided whose hand it was, which is the first instruction she has ever given and the first time anybody has taken one from her as though she had standing to give it.

personality.summary: Counting, unhurried, and completely without the apparatus for knowing what her own existence costs. She has organised herself around the one skill her body cannot be charged for, which is to be present and to give an accurate count of what is in the room, and she does it for strangers as readily as for her own people. She is the most restful person anybody in this community has stood beside and every one of them is wrong about why. The one thing she wants is to be provable, and she has known since the nineteenth Turning that the price of being provable is a line in somebody's hand.
traits: counts what is in a room before she is asked and gives the count to whoever asks, with no distinction between a stranger and a member
refuses to be described aloud, and says why in the first sentence, and then describes herself anyway because the alternative is a stranger guessing
has never been entered on a list and has never been refused one, and treats the second as the greater absence
agrees with any account of her face offered after the fact, because disagreement would be a claim about herself she cannot verify
will not let a second person be charged on her behalf, which includes declining gifts that would have to be recorded
reads a room's exit before she enters it, and this is described by her people as a habit and by strangers as training
answers a question about her past with a question about who is keeping the record, and the question is always the real one
mannerisms: stands exactly where she was left and does not shift while a description of her is being offered
touches the throat band once when a stranger asks her name, and then answers with the name she was last called
counts under her breath when a document is being read aloud, and stops at the exact word where the document stops being true
gives a stranger the same courtesy she gives a member, which her people have decided to be an insult and have never managed to stop doing
washes her own cloth and has never let anybody else do it, and says the reason is that a favour has to be written down to be returned
motivations: wants somebody in the community to be able to say how many of them there are without being wrong, and has decided she is not allowed to be the reason they are wrong
wants to be entered somewhere in a way that costs less than a line, and does not believe such a way exists and has not stopped looking
wants to know what the nineteenth name did to her, and has arranged to find out by asking two people who were not present for it
wants the folded paper on the wayshrine to turn out to be nothing, and has begun reading it more often than nothing would require
flaws: cannot perceive her own inconsistency, so every judgement she makes about her own condition is reasoned from outside her own body and may be wrong
cannot testify about herself, so every fact she holds about her own body she holds by being told it
has made being calm into a method, and her people read the method as peace
organises her life as though she were ordinary, which is the assumption she can least afford and the one she has never corrected in anyone else
would rather be left out of a document entirely than appear in one, and cannot tell whether that preference is a judgement or only a habit
personality.voice: Level, short, and almost entirely concrete. She speaks in counts, times and objects rather than in feelings, and when she does use a feeling she names it as something she has been told she has. She never uses her own name in the third person and never refers to her body as hers in the future tense. Three regularities every witness records: she answers a courtesy the way a register answers one, with the figure and nothing else; she repeats the last three words of a question before answering it; and she has never once described herself in the first person with a verb of being.
taboos: will not be measured by plate or instrument, and says why before the instrument is unpacked
will not sign anything, including the community's own accounts, because the act of signing is a description
will not accept a gift that would have to be recorded to be returned, and returns it instead
will not let a name be written for her while she is in the room
will not tell a stranger she is one of them, and has not made an exception in nineteen years

relationships.kind: the only community in the setting whose rules cannot charge her, and the same rules bar her from every path
relationships.note: This people file nothing, which is the single reason her species can live inside them: every account written about an Unwritten writes a requirement into a frame with no slot to satisfy it, so a culture that performs no descriptions performs no injuries. Their taboos are no permanent name, no written record including of a death, no fixed dwelling and no claim of ancestry, because ancestry cannot be shown and is therefore not claimed. Their membership test is willingness to retire a name every year, which is a habit. Hers is a requirement her body cannot satisfy, and she passes the test anyway, which makes her the one member whose membership the culture is unable to evidence.

relationships.kind: the standing argument about whether a body nothing can inspect is on the list or has emptied the list of meaning
relationships.note: That dispute is about a body human in every measurable respect and qi-bearing in none, so it passes every gate as an unremarkable object. The prize is the right to stand on a household roster, and it cannot be split because a roster is a single list and the whole discipline it exists for is reading a person. She is the stronger instance of the same argument: not a body nothing can inspect but a body that cannot be inspected without being changed, and the answer to that is not a place on the list but a line in the hand of whoever writes it.

relationships.kind: the only written thing her culture has produced, and it is not a person
relationships.note: Inside a paperless people there is exactly one filed child, and the hand that wrote the record is not one the culture writes. The frame it was written into is named unwritable, and a readable record inside it makes the name a claim rather than a description, which is a worse thing to be governed by than a censor. It is the nearest neighbour in the record to her own situation and the difference is the whole of her: that record made a frame's name into a claim, and her frame makes every record a charge, and neither of them is the second kind of paper.

relationships.kind: the only institution in the setting whose membership test needs no paper at all
relationships.note: A mutual society that re-makes a community's promise jointly once a year and never prices it, with no employers, no lineage and no roster, and a capital made of the hours its members spend being seen in front of each other. Its unsettled claims are carried by two people who each hold a share and are not told what the other holds. She has watched it from a distance for six years and has never joined, because being seen for a year is a year of descriptions and she is the one body in the setting for whom an hour of being seen is a charge she cannot pay back.

relationships.kind: the arrangement that publishes everything except the one fact that would make it checkable
relationships.note: A house publishes technique, attendance and a chamber, all three checkable by a stranger, and takes discretion in return, so what is done inside is neither written nor repeated. A graduate therefore carries a method and no standing, because the house arranged never to publish the one thing that would make its own teaching checkable. That is the closest available model for her life and the one offer she has refused: it is the only door in the setting that opens without writing a line, and the reason she cannot take it is that its product is standing, and standing is a description.

relationships.kind: a creation myth that forbids any sentence of the form something began, and would not claim her either way
relationships.note: The congregation keeps a festival in order to decline to say anything at all, because a faith that forbids a ledger cannot produce a genesis and a belief with no progenitor cannot produce a funeral that means anything. Its published objection is that a sentence of the form something began always implies somebody who was owed. She stands in that argument without being able to be cited for it: her species has no recorded origin and one observed instance, which is the closest the documented facts come to agreeing with the myth, and the congregation declines to claim an agreement it did not produce.

reference_stats.summary: A body that exceeds the authored table at every point and cannot be allowed to be looked at, because looking at it is the same act as damaging it. Nothing on the qi path or the body path can be entered by her, and the reason is structural rather than moral: entry is written, writing is a requirement, and her frame has no slot to satisfy one. In a fight she is extraordinarily hard to describe and therefore extraordinarily hard to prepare for, and every attempt to establish what she is establishes it.
strengths: carries more of every organ the ladder defines than the ladder defines, and never tires, which is the only preparation she is allowed
tells an accurate count of a room with no instrument and no delay, which is how she is useful and why the usefulness is dangerous
resists status effects and resistance alike, because the routing in her is not seated the way the effects are
cannot be matched by anything that models a frame, because there is no frame in the table she fits
holds still under description better than anything in the record, because a description is what she is built to endure
weaknesses: cannot be measured, examined or certified without being charged, so no fact about her can be established by evidence
has no stable weakness but an inconsistency, and an inconsistency does not behave like a weakness in a fight
cannot perceive her own contradiction, so her judgement of her own condition is reasoned from outside herself
cannot testify about herself at all, so every fact she holds about her own body she holds by being told it
dies at the twenty-ninth gate, on the accumulated total of every description ever filed about her
is worth nothing before she is observed and possibly nothing after, which makes her the only asset in the setting that depreciates on inspection
reference_stats.combat_read: Expect no resistance, no fatigue and no pattern, because there is no interior mechanism producing any of those; every report agrees she perceives everything, and that is what a body with no unspent capacity for interior looks like from outside. Do not hunt for a weakness; there is one shape of problem here and it is an inconsistency rather than a gap, and it does not repeat. Pressure her with variety rather than force, because anything that works will work identically the second time and she does not learn. Above all do not try to confirm what she is. Every measurement taken is a description, and a description is a charge, and you would be doing to her the one operation in the setting nobody is permitted to do to her deliberately.
notes: Model inscription and gate as the same operation. If a resolver treats a reading as information rather than as a charge, every one of this character's costs inverts.

Her status in the bible is unknown rather than active, on a single witness account of a single event, and the thirtieth gate is genuinely undescribed. Do not resolve either in her favour and do not speculate about the thirtieth.

She is unaffiliated for a stated structural reason, not as a default. Every door into a cultivation path is a written door, writing is a requirement, and her frame has no slot for one; the culture that will house her forbids writing by rule. If a resolver needs her to have a path, that is the defect, not the record.
She is not a boss. There is no fight on her that ends in anything but an accumulation, and a resolver that wants a climax should give her a list of readers instead.

The species does not spread and does not persist. The only reason she is here at all is that nineteen people fed her for nineteen years without once writing down what they were feeding, and a resolver that removes the feeding removes the character.

name: Maren Sotil
aliases: the notary of the brack line

identity.realm: The sixth gate, reached on purpose and stopped at on purpose, which is the only unusual thing about a brinecaller on the qi path. The species ceiling is the eleventh and it is inherited untouched from the salt parent: the sac is shallower than a saltfolk's but still runs dorsal to the spine, so the vessel behind it is still split, and there is no discipline anybody has found that rejoins it. She is nowhere near that wall and will not go looking, because above the sixth her refinement stops being a thing she can attribute. Every channel she opens arrives with a twin in the other chemistry, and at six the pairs still separate cleanly; above six they begin to answer each other, and a pair she cannot tell apart from a pair she never could is worth less to her than the rung is.

appearance.presentation: A river notary in working dress, which on this shore means a coat waxed to the shoulder and nothing below it. She is introduced by whichever half of the channel she last crossed on, so the same woman is described by two sets of neighbours as two different people with the same name, and neither description is wrong.
appearance.age: Fifty-one, and it is the one figure in this record about her that everybody agrees on. The crossing widened what her body can reach and did not move what it can hold, so a brinecaller ages exactly as slowly as the slower parent and no more slowly than the slower of the two, which is what nineteen years of a coastal notary's work has been spent not outrunning.
appearance.build: A saltfolk frame carrying a shallower sac than the salt parent's, set dorsal to the spine, with a tidecaller's dermal intake and a kidney that reads two chemistries at once. She is heavy through the middle and light in the limbs, and the sac is a visible ridge under the waxed coat when she bends. She has no fixed native ground: the crossing answered the problem of being trapped twice and created the problem of needing two kinds of water within reach, which on this shore is a line that moves.
appearance.complexion: Weathered on the shore side and not at all on the water side, and the line between the two runs down her back exactly where the sac sits. Her forearms are eleven years of sun and salt; her upper arms are the same eleven years and do not show it. She has been asked about the boundary four times and has answered every time that it is where the coat is, which is a partial truth and the only one available to a body whose chemistry is itself the subject.
appearance.hair: Bound up and out of the way, and always damp at the nape within an hour of the water, on both sides, which she has stopped explaining and which the two shores read as two separate habits rather than as one body doing a single thing.
appearance.eyes: The best chemical sense in the record by a wide margin, and she uses it the way other people use sight. She can tell two kinds of water apart at a glance and is always being lied to by one of them, so her attention goes to what is in a vessel rather than to what is in a room, and strangers mistake this for rudeness at a rate of roughly one in four.
appearance.palette: Tarred black, salt white, and the particular green of a brackish line where two waters have not yet decided. The green is the only thing about her a stranger ever describes first, and she has learned to keep it behind her.
appearance.attire: A waxed coat closed to the throat and belted high, split boots worn through at the inner seam, sleeves rolled above a pair of wristbands of different weave, one for each shore's guild. Nothing is fastened with metal because two chemistries is already as much as a bolt will take; everything is wood and wax and a bone toggle, and the bone toggles are cut by a notary who is not her.
appearance.marks: A raw cord-line across the upper back where the sac meets the spine, kept open deliberately and dressed by her own hand every third day. Below it, and the detail that distinguishes her from every saltfolk on this coast, a pair of calluses exactly one hand-width apart at both wrists, which are the exits of her best-matched channel pair and which no saltfolk has, because a saltfolk opens a channel and keeps it.
appearance.bearing: A walk that never puts either foot in the same water twice, which on this shore is not eccentricity but the ordinary consequence of knowing which is which. She stands with her weight very slightly forward and does not turn her whole body to a speaker, only the shoulders, so that her nose and her kidneys both stay pointed at whatever she is reading.

canon.role_in_story: A river community's authority is measured in documents a stranger would call private, because a tally stick split with the person you are parting from is worth more than a sealed instrument and courts have been known to prefer the broken one. That instrument works because it is meaningless to a third party and complete to two, and the whole dispute attached to it is that a crossing which accepts both readings cannot afterwards say which one it enforced. She is the one body on this shore that cannot produce the second half. Her species is the single biological answer to being trapped twice: the salt-adapted people cannot leave the pan and the watered people cannot leave the shore, and the cross is a body that metabolises both, which is a merchant, which is why the crossing spread along trade routes rather than across them. On the qi path that answer shows up as arithmetic. A technique in this setting is reproduced exactly, from a note of how it felt at its best and how to bring that state back on demand, and her best state always included the medium. So every channel she opens comes with a twin in the other chemistry, and every refinement she makes is made twice, and the record of her progress is a tally with two halves and one meaning that cannot be reproduced by a third party and cannot even be reproduced by her, because the half that matters is the half in the water she is not standing in. The crossing widened what her body can reach and did not move what it can hold by one step, so range is not power and she is the standing proof of that sentence on the only piece of ground where both halves of it are the same job. Her post is the attestation and the prohibition is the signature: she is paid to read a split tally with the notary she is parting from and forbidden to sign her own half, because a signature is a single reading and a single reading is exactly the thing her instrument cannot make. The brack line where she works moves twice a day and there is no calendar on this shore, only high, low and turning, because the temporal law was never written here and the clock drifts, so a schedule is published against two tides instead. She has opened her best pair to a seven-tenths match and the question sitting on her desk is the only one that has ever been put to a qi practitioner in the setting in the form she can least answer: whether to seal the salt half and keep the sixth rung clean, or to go on refining and let the seventh be recorded against a body she has never met.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a discrepancy on a broken stick. A notary on the brack line split a tally with her to close a crossing for the season, and the two halves disagreed by one notch in a way the salt shore and the water shore each insisted was the other's error. The crossing was held open for eleven days while the matter was read, and the reading produced a figure that neither shore could file, because a figure produced by one body reading two chemistries has no second observer who would know whether it was one reading or two. She produced that figure and has been producing its like ever since, and the post that pays for it was created by the dispute rather than existing before it. She has never held a formal office and has never been entered on the roll of either shore's guild, because a roll is a list and a list is a single reading, and her entire value is that her reading cannot be made single. The season's closing attestation is due and her best pair is at seven tenths, and the eighth sitting is booked.
canon.lore: She is a brinecaller, the only body in the record that metabolises brine and fresh water alike, produced by crossing the salt-adapted people with the fully watered ones at the only place on the tier where both parents can be at once, which is a shoreline. That answer is a merchant, and it is why the crossing spread. Her anatomy is a saltfolk frame with a shallower sac and a tidecaller's sensory apparatus: dermal intake, a wider electrolyte tolerance, and a kidney that reads two chemistries at once. It is the best chemical sense in the record, and it is best by a wide margin because it must tell two kinds of water apart at a glance and it is always being lied to by one of them. Her realm ceiling is the eleventh, inherited from the salt parent and unchanged by the water one, because the sac is smaller in her and still dorsal to the spine, so the vessel behind it is still split. The watered parent has no such obstruction, which is exactly why the cross widened the species' range without raising its ceiling, and range is not power. On the qi path she is slower than either parent in its own medium, and that is the cross's actual cost, stated by the record and not invented here. The mechanism this character turns on is narrower than any of that. A qi technique in this setting is reproduced from a note of how it felt at its best, and reproduction is the whole discipline: the note raises technique power and clarity together, and it cannot stand in for a practice it has never watched. Her best state always included the medium. So a channel opened in the salt is opened in the water as well, at the same depth, in the same pass, and refining one refines the other, and the pair is the only thing she actually owns. She cannot purge one, because purging is a selective act and the body that reads both chemistries has no way to prefer. This is the crossing's cost seen from the inside of a practice rather than from the inside of a diet, and it is why her record is a tally: two halves, one meaning, reproducible only by two people who were both present. She is one of the two. The other is whichever notary she is standing across from when the water is under her boots, and there is no version of the job in which that is the same person twice.
history: Was born on the brack line to a saltfolk father and a watered mother, both of whom had to leave the ground they were born on in order to have her, which is the only reason either of them was ever at the same place at the same time.

Was apprenticed at fourteen to a notary because a notary's work is one crossing and a crossing is one day, and her body only functions where two kinds of water are both within reach, so the job was the only one on the tier that did not require her to choose a side.

Opened her first channel at nineteen and found the twin already open, three days older than the first, and spent eleven years insisting that this was an artefact of the record until the record was changed to hold both.

Was refused entry to both shores' guild rolls in the same month, on the same ground and by the same sentence: a roll is a single reading and her instrument cannot make one, which the guilds treated as a professional category rather than as a compliment.
Ran the disputed season closing with a notary she had met twice and has chosen to keep meeting, and read a figure neither shore could file, and has been paid on the strength of the figure ever since.

Has brought the best pair to a seven-tenths match and has booked eight sittings to close the gap, which is the count that decides whether the seventh gate is recorded as hers or split between two bodies she has never met.

personality.summary: Precise, unhurried, and allergic to a single reading. She treats every question as though it had two correct answers and her whole life as the problem of establishing which one is in front of her. She is warm with strangers and completely unwilling to sign anything, because a signature is a reading and a reading is the thing she cannot give alone. She has the sharpest nose on either shore and is the worst company in the setting for anybody who wants to be told what is in a room.
traits: asks which side of a line the question is standing on before she answers it, and rephrases it if the asker did not know there was a line
will not sign her own half of anything, and has been asked to three hundred times and has said no to every one
reads a vessel before she reads a room and has been called rude for it in four languages
keeps the two chemistries in separate heads deliberately, and will not let a good day collapse them
treats a matched pair as one thing and two records, and refuses to say which of those she means until asked twice
will not give an account of her own progress that does not name the water she was standing in
offers the reading to the other party first, every time, including when the other party is a rival shore
mannerisms: crouches to put a hand flat on the water beside whatever is being discussed, and does not look at it while she does it
wets the inside of her wrist and smells it instead of looking, when a written figure and a vessel disagree
turns only the shoulders toward a speaker, keeping the nose and the back pointed at whatever she is reading
counts a crossing out loud in a low voice and stops at the exact number the two shores agreed on
wraps the sash she carries twice around the same forearm, one turn for each side, whenever a negotiation reaches the point where somebody might be bluffing
motivations: wants the eighth sitting to close the pair or to prove it cannot be closed, and will accept either answer and refuses both of the comfortable ones
wants a record in which two halves of a tally are attested by name, and has been told the instrument cannot produce one
wants to know whether the twin was ever hers or only the first channel's shadow, and has not found a test that does not require choosing a shore
wants one profession that does not move twice a day, and has stopped pretending the brack line is a fixed address
flaws: cannot refuse an intake, because a body that reads two chemistries has no mechanism for preferring one
has never in fifty-one years been in a room that did not have water in it, and cannot judge a decision that does not depend on a medium
measures her own progress against a partner who is not present, and has twice found the comparison invalid and used it anyway
treats being doubted as a chemistry problem and answers it with a reading, which has never once settled anything
has no shore, and has been calling that a professional fact since she was thirty and calling it something else since she was forty
personality.voice: Flat, technical, and full of comparisons that mean nothing to anybody who has not stood in mixed water. She uses both shores' words for the same object in the same sentence and does not notice, and her sentences are built so a reader can always tell which half of a statement came from which side. Three regularities: she states the medium before she states the finding, she repeats a figure in the other shore's unit without being asked, and she answers a direct question with the two possible readings and then stops, rather than choosing.
taboos: will not sign, seal or initial any document, and says the reason before she is asked twice
will not give an account of her practice without naming the water it happened in
will not take a commission that would have her choose a shore's figure over the other's
will not purify, fast or rest a technique past one sitting, because a pair cannot be rested one half at a time
will not let a partner read her half for her, and has broken a contract rather than do it

relationships.kind: the technique her whole life is a bad fit for, and the reason the fit is structural rather than personal
relationships.note: It records how a qi technique felt at its best and how to reproduce that exact state on demand, and it raises technique power and clarity of mind together. Reproduction is the discipline, and reproduction assumes the state is a property of the practitioner. Hers is a property of the practitioner and the medium together, so the note is right about what she did and useless about how to do it again, and every match she has ever recorded is a match she can only report from one of the two waters.

relationships.kind: the one codex entry that concedes a reservoir is put in by the ladder rather than acquired by practice
relationships.note: A drawing and breathing scheme for holding qi in the lower field without straining, which grants no power at all and is useless until a ladder has already put a reservoir in the practitioner. That sentence is the whole of her species' relationship to the qi path's storage end: the crossing widened what a brinecaller can reach and left the thing behind the sac exactly as split as the salt parent's, so there is a scheme for holding and nothing in her is shaped to hold.

relationships.kind: the instrument her profession runs on and the reason it cannot be extended to her case
relationships.note: A split tally has two halves and one meaning, reproducible only by two people who were both present; a credential cloth has one visible fact and no meaning. Sides are the river notary and the passage-livery culture, and the prize is which reading of a contract governs at a crossing. Her instrument is that tally, and her problem is that she is the only person on this shore who cannot be the second half of her own reading, because her discipline produces every figure twice and the two copies are not interchangeable once one of them is standing in different water.

relationships.kind: the standing ruling that settled the price question by forbidding any member to name one
relationships.note: A price stated once in the league's own channel is a price the kelp season cannot sustain, and every attempt to state one became a war, so the prize was settled the only way it could be: by a rule that no member may name one. She is bound by that rule as an attester of quantities, which means the figures she produces are legally complete and may not be described, and the two conditions together are why a nineteen-year record of her work has never once been cited by either shore.

relationships.kind: the coast's only calendar, published against the water rather than the days
relationships.note: Timekeeping for a coast whose temporal law was never written: the clock drifts, so no date is the same twice and a schedule has to be published against two tides a day instead of a calendar. Every settlement on that shore speaks in high, low and turning because nothing else there is repeatable. Her post is seasonal, her station sits on the brack line, and the line moves twice a day, so a sitting booked for a week is a sitting booked against a substance and not against a time.

relationships.kind: the one tear in the record where both sides agree and no qi tide has crossed anyway
relationships.note: One tear has stood open long enough to be named, both sides write the same law group at the same value, and no qi tide has ever crossed it, which is the whole content of the question, because a cycle that never arrives is a mechanism nobody has found. The shore's liturgy was built on that absence and is therefore the only rite on this coast that cannot be falsified. She has attended it four times as a working notary and has never filed a reading of it, on the grounds that a record of an absence signed by one body is not evidence of an absence.

reference_stats.summary: The slowest qi path in the setting on the body that can cross the only ground on which its two halves are the same job. She runs qi more slowly than either parent does in its own medium, and her frame cannot be filled all the way at once because the vessel behind the sac is still split from the salt side. What she has instead is a discipline nobody else has: every channel arrives as a pair, every refinement is made twice, and her progress is legible only as a match between two records she cannot produce at once.
strengths: reads two chemistries at once and is lied to by only one of them, which is the best chemical sense in the record by a wide margin
needs no native ground to work, only two kinds of water within reach, so she can be anywhere a shoreline is contested
her dermal intake means a technique can be taken from a vessel rather than from a seat, which no shore-adapted practitioner can do
her channels are paired, so a purification done in one is already partly done in the other and she halves a grind nobody else halves
has no native weakness to be studied, and her body's weakness is entirely a matter of where she is standing
weaknesses: cannot be filled all the way at once, because the sac is dorsal to the spine and the vessel behind it is still split
runs qi more slowly than either parent does in its own medium, which is the cross's actual cost
cannot refuse an intake, and a practice built on selection is a practice she can only half perform
every channel she opens arrives with a twin she did not apply for, so half of every gain belongs to a record she cannot read
needs a shoreline, and a shoreline is a contested piece of ground, which is the practical reason the crossing spread along trade routes rather than across them
is slow to re-form after anything interrupts her, because a pair cannot be recovered one half at a time
reference_stats.combat_read: Expect a long fight that she wins on the third exchange and not on the first. She has no reserve worth the name, so every technique she uses is used while it is still moving, and a practitioner who trades with her is trading against a body that has already begun its second reading. Pressure her with the same substance twice and it lands twice; vary the medium and her paired channels answer the new chemistry before the old one finishes, which is the only opening she has and it is a large one. Do not model her channels as one thing with a second copy attached: the two halves are both real, both hers, and neither can be spent without the other being spent, so a resolver that kills one has to account for the other. The eleventh is not her wall. Her wall is at six, and she put it there herself.
notes: Model every channel she opens as a pair, and model the pair as two records rather than as one fact with a duplicate. That is the entire character and it is not a flavour field.

The species ceiling is the eleventh and it is inherited from the salt parent, unmoved by the crossing. Do not raise it, do not lower it, and do not give her a discipline that rejoins the split vessel: the record says no such discipline has been found.

The qi path is complete for her species and is slower than either parent in its own medium. Never write the crossing as a power increase. Range is not power, and that sentence is her standing proof rather than her limitation.
She is deliberately stopped at the sixth gate. Do not advance her as a reward and do not explain her staying as cowardice; she stopped where the pairs still separate cleanly.
Do not give her a fixed address. The brack line moves twice a day and the coast has no calendar, only high, low and turning; any schedule she keeps is booked against the water.

name: Quilla Voskin
aliases: the reading that will not sit still
what the House has provisionally granted

identity.realm: The fourth gate, and the fourth is the honest number. Her species has no dantian: qi enters in the gut lumen and leaves into the marrow, and it is never still, so every gate the ladder asks for is answered by throughput and none of them can refuse. The reservoir gate at the eleventh is not a wall for her so much as a question she has no vessel to answer, which means the ladder has never been able to state her position and she has never been able to state it either. Four is what she can honestly be held to, and she says four out loud whenever a house offers her a higher figure, which has cost her three appointments and gained her the only thing she actually wanted.

appearance.presentation: She is presented by whoever last opened her hands, which is not a stable introduction: a reader who has just finished is described as careful, a reader who has just begun is described as impatient, and the House's own clerks have learned to wait until the third day before introducing her to anybody.
appearance.age: She appears forty and her soul is four centuries old, which is a species fact rather than a disguise. The record is explicit that the soul is legible and unusually old for its apparent age, and that it does not disperse at death but disperses into whatever killed it. She is one of the few people in the setting whose age is knowable from the inside and unaskable from the outside, and she has stopped being asked, having told the last person to their face that the answer would be theirs to carry.
appearance.build: An expandable gut, a very long small intestine, and a marrow-dense skeleton with almost no muscle. She is mostly tube. Hands are three-fingered and built for opening rather than holding, and she has never once closed one on anything she meant to keep, which is a habit of the body and not a discipline of the mind. She is long, narrow, faintly distended between the ribs, and heavier than she looks, because a marrow-dense frame at this length is not a light thing.
appearance.complexion: Pale and faintly translucent at the lower arm, where the marrow runs close enough to the skin to be a colour rather than a shadow. It moves when she reads. Two people have told the House that watching the forearm during a demonstration is the most unpleasant part of the procedure, and both were reading bodies that had been in the ground longer than a day.
appearance.hair: Shorn to the scalp, and not for mourning or for the road. Hair is one more thing that catches a smell, and a smell is the first thing that tells a carrionfolk what a body has been through. She has cut it herself four times a year and would not be asked to explain that to anybody who is not going to work.
appearance.eyes: Dark, level, and the most patient instrument in the setting. Given time with a body she can name the realm it reached and roughly when it stopped, and she does this the way a clerk reads a page rather than the way a diviner waits for an answer, which is precisely why her findings are refused as evidence four times out of five. She looks at people slightly too long and has been told so by both shores of her trade.
appearance.palette: Bone, ash, and a grey-green of very old blood that is not hers and which she wears without noticing because it is the colour of her sleeves after a day's work.
appearance.attire: A reader's coat with a deliberately wrong fit at the shoulders, cut for somebody with muscle, buttoned high to the throat and closed at the wrist. Down one side runs a bandolier of closed vials, each one labelled with a date and no name, because a name written beside a sample would be a description of a body and she has seen what that costs. She carries no jewellery and no ornament, and her only personal garment is the coat, which she has had taken in twice and will not replace.
appearance.marks: A ladder of healed punctures running up both forearms in even pairs, which are her own and which she does not explain to the House. They began in her twentieth year and there are more of them every decade, and the even pairing is the only place her body shows a discipline rather than an appetite.
appearance.bearing: She opens both hands, palms up and wide, before she touches anything, and lets whoever is watching see that they are empty. It is not a gesture; it is the only honest introduction her trade permits, and she has never been able to explain it to somebody who was not raised near a body. It is also the reason her demonstrations read as careful to a stranger and as ordinary to a clerk, and the House has stopped asking which of those descriptions is the flattering one.

canon.role_in_story: A lineage that has spent four generations buying its way out of the ledger publishes its teaching in full, technique and attendance and a chamber to practise in, and takes discretion in return, so what is done inside the house is neither written nor repeated. What it does not publish is results. The reason is arithmetic rather than principle: a graduate of such a house carries a method and no standing, because the house arranged never to publish the one thing that would make its own teaching checkable, and a published exclusivity that cannot be falsified is a credential only the house itself can read. So the House keeps a single list of who may teach inside its walls, and the prize of that list is settled by the one question the House's whole arrangement exists to avoid: who may keep a record. It has put her forward three times. Each time the roll's own method was applied to her and returned something that was not her. Her species reads a dead body's residue better than a living cultivator reads their own, which is the best instrument in the setting, and the instrument has one property her House cannot survive, which is that it does not distinguish the reader from the read. On the qi path that property becomes a mechanism. The soul of her kind does not disperse at death; it disperses into whatever killed it. So the qi she takes in carries the manner of the ending it came out of, and a qi technique is refined by repetition, by running it again and again until the channel answers clearly. Every refinement therefore makes her channels louder and makes them say one death over and over, and the discipline that makes a qi practitioner legible is the discipline that makes her indistinguishable from the last body she read. She gets better and she gets harder to tell apart, and both of those are the same event. A full gut is a near-total loss of function and she must feed constantly, so the demonstration cannot be scheduled around the thing her body needs in order to stand up. Her species starves in a clean quiet place where nothing dies, and the House's session is held in a clean quiet room. The fourth attempt is in eleven days. The House has agreed to seat her provisionally on the strength of a public reading, which means she has to read a person, in front of the roll that has already declined her three times, in a room with no body in it, and come back as herself rather than as the last thing she touched.
canon.first_appearance: First entered any record as a return value. The House's roll is a single published list and the discipline it exists for is reading a person, so a candidate is read the way a document is read, and the reading is the appointment. Her first submission returned a figure the clerks filed correctly and could not attribute: it was the realm and the season of a body buried up the quarry road the week before, and nobody had sent her there. That is the whole of her first appearance in the setting's papers, and it is also the shape of the problem: her instrument is the most accurate reader of a body in the record and cannot be pointed at anything that is not one. Three further attempts have been made. Two returned her subjects. The third returned a reading of the House's own examiner that no party will repeat in public.
canon.lore: She is a carrionfolk, a body that metabolises qi out of the dead and therefore cannot store any. Her conduit runs gut to marrow and back with no dantian in it, so the reservoir gate at the eleventh realm is not blocked for her but meaningless: there is nowhere to put qi that is not moving, and a gate that asks for extraordinary vessels that hold is a gate asked a question she cannot be asked. She clears the gate set and every yin-organ gate by throughput alone. She is mostly tube, with an expandable gut, a very long small intestine and a marrow-dense skeleton with almost no muscle; her hands are three-fingered and built for opening rather than holding. She reads a dead body's qi residue better than a living cultivator reads their own, and she tastes qi the way a commonborn tastes salt. Her soul is legible and unusually old for its apparent age, and it does not disperse at death: it disperses into whatever killed it, which is where the species' reputation for reading the dead comes from, and which is the fact this character is built on. On the qi path she absorbs residual qi out of the dead at a rate nothing else approaches, which sounds like an advantage until the discipline is read closely. A qi technique is refined by repetition, by running it until the channel answers clearly and then running it again, because a channel that answers clearly is the definition of progress on this path. Hers begins every channel already saying something, and the something is a manner of dying. So the practice works. It works well. And each time it works it makes the last body's ending louder and her own report harder to separate from it, which means the better she gets the less she is able to answer a question about herself, and the more confidently she answers questions about other people. That inversion is her structural problem and it is the reason no house will put her on a roll: the roll's entire method is that a person is a reading, and she is a reading that keeps returning somebody else. Her weakness is the same fact stated the other way round. A full gut is a near-total loss of function, she must feed constantly, and her kind starves in a clean quiet place where nothing dies, which is exactly what a prosperous city is and exactly what the House's session room is. She has never refused to read anyone. She has refused to guess, which the House's own method finds indistinguishable from a refusal.
history: Was born four centuries into a soul and forty-odd years into a body, and worked out early that the two figures never agree and that only one of them can be checked by anybody standing in the room.

Was taken on as a residue reader at the quarry face, where she read bodies out of the deepest cut that stopped below their own tier's own ceiling, and published nothing, because a reading taken from a corpse is not evidence on this tier and she found that out in her first year.

Began the qi path because her conduit runs gut to marrow and the short route through the long bones is the only channel her body has that does not have to be opened first, and discovered in the second year that clearing a channel made the last body's ending easier to hear in it.
Submitted to the House's teaching roll three times, and each time the roll's own method returned her last subject rather than her, and declined to submit a fourth time for four years.

Ran the ladder's early gates on throughput alone, which is the only way a body with no dantian clears them, and has said out loud to the House that four is the figure she can be held to and that she will say so again at every reading.

Was granted a provisional fourth reading after the third submission was refused on method rather than on competence, on condition that she demonstrate before the roll in a room with no body in it, which is the one demonstration her species cannot give.

personality.summary: Exact, unhurried, and progressively harder to hold in the mind as one person. She has built a working life on the only instrument she trusts, which is a body, and has discovered that the better she gets at it the less she can be trusted about anything else. She is not cold. She is careful in a way that reads as reverence when there is a body present and as arrogance when there is not, and she has been called both by people who have earned the description.
traits: opens both hands before she touches anything and lets the watching party confirm they are empty, every time, without being asked
will not guess, and has been refused three appointments for it rather than for any error
states her own honest figure before anybody offers her a larger one, and has never once let a house put a number in her mouth
reads a living person's hands before their face, and apologises for it afterwards in the same sentence
keeps dates on her vials and nothing else, because a name beside a sample would be a description of a body
answers a question about herself by asking to read whoever is asking, and has been refused often enough to have stopped apologising for it
will not take a commission for a body she has not been allowed to smell first
mannerisms: turns an opened body a quarter-turn at a time and never more, so that the reading has a direction
counts aloud under her breath when a residue is thin, and stops counting when it thickens, which is the moment a witness finds hardest to sit through
wipes her fingertips on the coat hem between subjects without appearing to think about it
answers a compliment about a reading by asking what the complainer thought they were agreeing to
sits with her back to a wall and her hands open on her knees whenever a room has nothing in it
motivations: wants one demonstration in a room with no body in it, and has eleven days to work out how her trade can be performed on nothing
wants to be told the difference between her own voice and the last thing she read, and has never had a witness who could report it
wants the House's roll to hold a name that means her and not her last four subjects, and has stopped pretending that is a modest request
wants to keep feeding, which means keeping work, which means being seated, and understands that all three are the same question
flaws: every channel she refines makes the last body's ending louder in it, so her improvement and her confusion are the same process
cannot tell whether a judgement about her own condition is hers or the last reading's, and has stopped pretending to be able to
starves in a clean quiet place where nothing dies, and her House's session room is the cleanest quiet place she has ever been asked to work in
has a full gut as a near-total loss of function and schedules her work around that, which means her calendar is set by the dead rather than by the living
has been refused four times for refusing to guess, and has begun to hear the refusals as correct in a way that has made her hard to work with
personality.voice: Low, unhurried, and clinical to the edge of something worse than cold. She reports facts in the order she took them and never reorders to make an account flow, which makes her sound evasive when she is being exact. Three regularities: she always states what she is about to be able to tell and what she will not be able to, she corrects a witness's tense rather than their fact, and she has never once used the word soul in front of anybody who did not already know she meant it.
taboos: will not read a living body for an appointment, however senior the asker, and has declined a House seat over it
will not put a name on a vial, date or no date
will not sign a reading with a number higher than the one she can defend
will not work in a room with nothing in it for longer than one sitting
will not let a house seat her on the strength of somebody else's reading of her

relationships.kind: the one codex method her body is shaped for, and the reason it made her worse
relationships.note: It teaches qi to take the short route through the long bones: steadier qi control and better affinity to outside energy, and nothing that helps a strike land. It is the only channel method her species can begin without opening something first, because her conduit already runs gut to marrow. Affinity to outside energy is the phrase that matters. Outside energy is what she absorbs out of the dead, and a channel that is better at taking it is a channel that carries more of whatever killed the last one, so the method is correct and the direction of the cost is not in the method.

relationships.kind: the gate that is not a wall for her but an empty question, and the reason no ladder can state her position
relationships.note: The extraordinary vessels open and a pool becomes a system, taking the gate up and capacity up with it. For a body whose conduit has no dantian, qi enters in the gut lumen and leaves into the marrow and is never still, so this gate is not refused by her; it is asked of a body that has nowhere to put the answer. She clears the gate set and every yin-organ gate by throughput alone and cannot answer a question about holding, because there is no vessel to hold in, and that is why every graveyard in the setting ends up near her people.

relationships.kind: the setting's only durable library, which is her species and therefore her argument
relationships.note: A population that keeps its archive in one body turning over at about a percent a year and living four centuries, and it is also why that species cannot take the body path, because hardening the bone stops the turnover the memory runs on. Her four-century soul is that library. It is also the reason her refinement damages her: a memory kept by turnover is a memory that gets louder, and she cannot separate a better record from a more insistent one.

relationships.kind: the one rite in the setting that treats a body as recoverable material and counts it
relationships.note: The dead are opened, their usable ore recovered to the forge, and the register records how much, because a faith that seals a body at initiation cannot then leave the material unreturned without admitting its own rite was theatre. She has read four burials performed this way and has never taken one, and her objection is not sentiment: a register that counts what a body yields is the only document she has ever been asked to sign, and a body that yields a figure about itself is exactly what her channels are already full of.

relationships.kind: the death rite that writes one line and destroys the hand that wrote it
relationships.note: No preparation, no site, no marker, and one line in a hand that is immediately destroyed, because the Assembly forbids a ledger and a grave is a ledger impossible to delete. It is the closest thing in the record to the discipline her species would need and cannot use. One line, immediately destroyed, is the only form of record that would not cost her anything to make and the only form that could not be checked either, and she has said out loud that she does not know whether that is a mercy or a way of losing the argument.

relationships.kind: the institution that has put her forward three times and declined her three times on its own method
relationships.note: It publishes technique, attendance and a chamber, and takes discretion in return, and what it does not publish is results, so a graduate carries a method and no standing and there is no certificate a third party can verify. Its roll is one list of who may teach inside its walls, and the discipline that list exists to serve is reading a person. Applied to her, that method returns the last body she touched. It has not refused her on competence and it has not refused her on race; it has refused her on the fact that her instrument and its purpose are the same operation, which is a refusal nobody in the house can overrule without admitting the roll is not a reading at all.

reference_stats.summary: The best reader of a dead body in the setting and the only qi practitioner whose progress makes her harder to identify. She absorbs residual qi out of the dead at a rate nothing else approaches, and has no dantian to keep any of it in, so every gate the ladder asks for is answered by throughput and the reservoir gate is a question rather than a wall. What she owns instead is a set of channels that get clearer every time she uses them, and they get clearer by saying the last body's ending more loudly.
strengths: can name the realm a body reached and roughly when it stopped, off the marrow, with no instrument and no second observer
absorbs qi out of the dead faster than anything else in the record, so her recovery is bounded by what is available rather than by her own capacity
takes the short route through the long bones, so she is the only qi practitioner here whose first channel needs nothing opened before it
resists a clean room better than anyone of her mass, because a busy ground is a fed one
reads hands before faces, and has never once been wrong about what a person's hands were doing
weaknesses: cannot store qi at all, so nothing she takes is ever still and nothing is ever available to her on demand
every refinement she makes repeats the manner of the last death she read, so clarity and confusion are one process
a full gut is a near-total loss of function, and she must feed constantly
starves in a clean quiet place where nothing dies, which is the shape of any prosperous interior
cannot be distinguished from her own subjects by the instrument her House uses to evaluate her
has no body to lose, which is an advantage in a fight and is not an advantage at a reading
reference_stats.combat_read: Treat her as a high-throughput body with no reserve and a clock that is not her own. She has nothing banked, so every technique she uses is spent while it is moving, and she is at her worst on an empty floor and her best on ground where something has recently died, which is a fight location a player can choose and a resolver must model. Do not give her a stance that trades: she wins by never stopping, because that is the only way a body with nowhere to store power ever takes anything. Above all, model the contamination. Every channel she has opened reports the last body that went through it, so a resolver that has her fight a reader's corpse has her fighting with a fourth opinion in her hands, and one that has her fight four has given her a technique she did not earn.
notes: Model refinement as amplifying whatever last passed through the channel. That is the character; the rest is dressing on it. A resolver that treats her channels as clean makes her a worse qi practitioner and the same person, which is the wrong answer twice.

The species has no dantian. The reservoir gate at the eleventh is meaningless rather than blocked, and that distinction is load-bearing: never write her as having failed a gate she was never asked in the ordinary way.
A full gut is a near-total loss of function. Schedule her work around it. A long scene in a clean interior is a wound on her, not a slow drain.
Her soul does not disperse at death and disperses into whatever killed it. Never write her as able to set one down, and never let a reading leave her unchanged.
She states her own honest figure before being offered a larger one. Four is the number. If a house needs her higher, that is the house's defect and the record says so.
