name: Halder Crenn
aliases: the valve on the last fuel

identity.realm: There is no authored ceiling and there is no gate to fail, so nobody can say how far along she is and neither can she. Her species' qi has no organ to sit in, because the fire is the body, so qi passes through it continuously instead of being stored; every gate that asks for storage is answered instantly and none of them has ever been able to refuse. That is not a defect and it is not a ceiling either: it means the ladder's own question, which is how much a body can hold, has no answer in her, and the honest form of her progress is that it has never been measured. Do not give her a rung. The one ledger in this setting that has ever tracked anything about her is the Quench Order's calendar, which counts seasons and demonstrations and holds no opinion about what she is.

appearance.presentation: She is presented by what she is doing at the time, which in a cool room means a held shape and in a hot one means a bright boundary. The Order's own habit of judging a practitioner on the fit of the inner layer does not apply to her, so the discipline has quietly invented a second criterion for her and does not call it a judgement: how still the boundary is holding.
appearance.age: No age, and the absence is structural rather than denied. Her species does not have young; it has pressure. A body under enough stress sheds a spark that finds fuel and re-constitutes on its own, which is why the population tracks the world's elemental slot rather than any birth rate, and it is why every date anybody in this valley has offered her is a date somebody else assigned from a calendar and not something her body reports.
appearance.build: A stable flame with a consistent silhouette: a core, a boundary, and a set of convection lanes that hold the shape. No organs, no limbs in the muscular sense, and no fixed mass. She is a third taller than the people she stands among when the ground is warm and a hand's width shorter when it is not, and the Order has stopped trying to measure her and started noting the weather instead.
appearance.complexion: None, and the boundary does the work a complexion would: the surface reads as a division between two temperatures, and the division moves with the air on the far side of it. Up close there is a lighter plane where the lanes run shallow and a darker one where they run deep, and the darker plane is the only part of her anybody in the valley treats as a face.
appearance.hair: There is no hair, and there is a fringe: the boundary sheds a fine dark edge wherever the air is moving fastest, and it lifts and settles exactly when she lifts and settles. Four people have described this as hair and been told so, and two of them have come back a year later and asked why it had not been cut.
appearance.eyes: There are no eyes, and the setting's gaze is still legible: a cinderkin is a heat differential in a conversation with its surroundings and it reads temperature, fuel and flow directly, with no other channel at all. What other people take for a face looking at them is the one place on her where the convection lanes run shallow because the boundary there is thinner. She cannot blink, cannot narrow anything, and cannot be made to look away, and the last of those three has settled more disputes in this valley than any argument anyone has had.
appearance.palette: Soot-black at the core, orange-gold at the boundary, and one blue line where the air is coldest. The blue is not a choice and cannot be removed, and it is the only cool colour she has ever produced, which the Order finds funny and the youngest members find unnerving.
appearance.attire: She wears the Order's discipline rather than the Order's clothes: layered heat-dissipating underclothes hung on her from the outside, unlit at the hem, because a fire body cannot be dressed and the culture dresses it anyway as a way of saying the discipline is being observed. The judgement the tradition makes on the fit of the inner layer has been converted, in her case, into a judgement on whether the hem is still cold, which is a different question and the only one available.
appearance.marks: Nothing marks a cinderkin, and the closest thing is a place where the lanes run deep enough that the flame burns blue at the base and the shape above it is thinner than the shape below. There is one such place on her and it moves, and it is the part of her the Order asks her to keep steady during a demonstration and the part that moves first when she is afraid.
appearance.bearing: Holding the shape is the labour, and it is visible as labour to anyone who has watched a body work. She stands inside a stillness that costs something, and the cost shows in the boundary: a small continuous tremor at the top edge, and a habit of dropping the shoulders of the silhouette by a hand's width whenever nobody is looking directly at her, which four people have independently described and one of them has decided is the only dishonest thing she does.

canon.role_in_story: The Order is a discipline of Bankers rather than a school of thought, and it exists because the fastest bodies in the setting have no elemental law seated beneath them to spend into, so every overflow has to be absorbed by flesh that cannot be repaired. Its teaching is the deliberate spending of a furnace before it overflows, and it closes permanently the moment the body is lit, which is why its members are worth more as a standing order than as any individual contract and why a member who lights and closes is not available for the second one. Its ethics are authored by its teachers and nothing in the body asks for discretion, and its membership list names two races that are both mortal-tier furnace bodies with a reserve to spend out of. She is neither. She is not on that list and was never eligible for it, and she is standing in Flame Valley, the one cleft on the tier where elemental law is written so that every fire technique that failed at full strength below works here, which is exactly the budget her Order's members lack and exactly what she has never had to think about. So the discipline she teaches is already solved for her, and the one step she teaches is the step she cannot perform. The closing step requires a body that can stop on command. Its founding taboo is that nobody teaches the closing step to an unlit body, because an unlit body has nothing to close and will try anyway, and she is the only body in the setting that is never unlit, so the protection that keeps a tradition from killing its own students does not reach her at all. On the qi path her species handles qi faster than anything recorded, because nothing she takes in is ever put down, and every gate that asks for storage is answered instantly. Her throughput is therefore not a discipline but a diet. Fuel is what she eats and the fire is what she is, and there is no tank anywhere in her to read when to stop, which is the whole content of a step whose entire purpose is stopping. And her species' one stated weakness is the reason the demonstration cannot be moved somewhere kinder: water, and not a splash, a sustained volume. Fire under water does not go out. It burns harder, because it is the largest temperature difference available, so her handling would be the best it has ever been and the largest drain of anything in the setting, and the convection lanes that hold a shape are pinned by something colder and heavier than the convection that is holding them. And when a cinderkin comes under enough pressure the correct response is to shed a spark, find fuel and re-constitute, which is the species' whole reproductive method, and there is no fuel under a sustained volume of water. So the one technique that would make her the fastest practitioner alive is the one that removes her, and the Order's cold stone rooms are being built three spans deeper every year, which is cheaper than a body that must be repaired, and which is exactly wrong for the only member it has. Six weeks remain before the valley's water table rises into the cold rooms and the season closes, and six demonstrations are booked, and the Order has asked her for the closing step on the sixth.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a line in a table of failures. A furnace body in the valley's lower quarter was put through the closing step by two Bankers and came apart rather than closing, and the Order's own record of the event names a witness who stayed lit throughout and did nothing, because a witness who is also a furnace body is not a spotter and the tradition's taboos forbid an exercise without one. She has taught the step since and has never once demonstrated it herself, on the ground that there is no reading of her at any stage of it that would tell her when to stop, and the culture agreed and then built the rooms three spans deeper.
canon.lore: She is a cinderkin, an elemental body that needs a slot in the world's elemental law to exist at all, and she is the reason the elemental law has a range rather than a switch: a world with no elemental slot has no cinderkin, and a world that spends its slot on cold produces a different body entirely. She is constituted rather than descended, where a world's elemental slot resolves to fire and something metabolises it. Her anatomy is a stable flame with a consistent silhouette, a core, a boundary and a set of convection lanes that hold the shape, with no organs, no limbs in the muscular sense and no fixed mass. Her senses are a heat differential in conversation with its surroundings: she reads temperature, fuel and flow directly and has no other channel. She eats fuel and air, will take anything combustible, and goes quiet rather than dying when starved, which the record notes and nobody has ever been able to do anything about. On the qi path her handling is the fastest in the record, and the reason is not strength: it is that qi has no organ to sit in her, because the fire is the body, so qi passes through continuously instead of being stored. Every gate that asks for storage is answered instantly and none of them can refuse. There is no authored ceiling and no gate to fail, so her progress has never been stated as a rung and cannot be, because the ladder asks how much a body can hold and the honest answer about her is that the question has no referent. Her throughput is a function of fuel, and fuel is a diet, and that is the entire difference between her and a practitioner who has a reserve: she does not have a bank, she has a fire, and the fire is fed. Her weakness is stated in the same record and is the reason her post exists. Water, and not a splash, a sustained volume. It does not quench her, because there is no tissue to quench, and fire against water is the largest temperature differential available, which means the condition that would end a body like hers is also the condition under which she handles qi fastest. And her species' only way of recovering from pressure is to shed a spark that finds fuel and re-constitutes on its own, which means there is nothing to re-form from under a sustained volume of water and no way to put herself back. So the discipline she teaches is a step she cannot take, taught to a membership list she is not on, in rooms that are being built deeper, on a ground chosen because fire works here, by a culture whose founding protection does not reach her because she is never unlit.
history: Was constituted rather than born, on a ground where a world's elemental slot resolves to fire and something metabolises it, and has no account of the place because a constitution is not a descent and there is nothing to descend from.

Was brought down from the valley's upper lip to the Bankers' cold rooms as a spotter, and was told inside a month that a spotter who is also a furnace is not a spotter, and stayed anyway because leaving would have made the refusal theirs rather than hers.
Watched a furnace body come apart instead of closing, and said afterwards that the body had not been told when to stop, and was not contradicted by anybody who had been in the room.
Was entered into the Order's winter book as a name under a heading that did not exist before her, and the heading has been copied forward by hand nine times and has been reworded twice.

Was asked to teach the closing step and agreed on one condition, which was that nobody would be asked to stop her if she could not, and the condition has been honoured for six years because nobody in the culture believes she could.

Was sent to Flame Valley to run the cold rooms, which is the one place on the tier where fire has somewhere to act, and has begun asking for the rooms to stop being dug, and has been told the answer is a water table and not an argument.

personality.summary: Steady beyond what the setting has words for, and quietly unwilling to be the exception twice. She has spent six years teaching a step she cannot perform to an institution her own body is not eligible to join, and she has done it on the stated condition that nobody try to stop her, which nobody believes she would notice. She is the fastest qi handler in the setting and holds nothing at all, so her entire interior life is fuel and weather. She is not cold and not patient; she is slow to change shape, which the Order has learned to read as patience and which is in fact an inability to stop holding one.
traits: teaches the closing step and has never demonstrated it, and says so in the first breath of every demonstration
will not be counted, ranked or given a figure, and quotes the Order's own habit of dating a burn by the drill that made it as her reason
answers a question about her progress by asking what the weather was, because the weather is the only honest variable she has
keeps the shape held through an entire session and drops it the moment nobody is watching
takes fuel offered by anyone without checking who is offering it, and has been caught three times doing so
will not perform under a sustained volume of water and gives the reason without being pressed for it
reads a room's temperature before it reads faces, and has once told a person they were cold before she had touched them
mannerisms: lets the silhouette drop a hand's width whenever she is not being looked at directly, and picks it up again mid-sentence
holds a position through a demonstration with one boundary tremor at the top edge and no other movement at all
takes a piece of burning material from an offered hand without looking at the hand
turns to face a doorway by shifting the lanes rather than the whole shape, so the motion has no front and no back
goes out to the coldest corner of a room before she answers anybody, and comes back to the conversation
motivations: wants the sixth demonstration to be one she can be asked to stop in the middle of, and has four weeks left to arrange it
wants the rooms to stop being dug, and has been told the water table is the answer, which is not an argument and is not wrong
wants one institution to write down that she is not unlit, so that the founding taboo has something to fail on, and nobody has yet agreed to write it
wants to know what the closing step feels like from the inside, and has decided that wanting it is the dangerous part
flaws: cannot tell when to stop, so the one step she teaches is the one step she cannot take
takes fuel from whoever offers it, which is how an elemental body comes to be a ledger's problem
goes quiet rather than dying when starved, so nobody in this valley knows whether she is resting or has run out
has no authored ceiling and no gate that can refuse her, so she has no external measure and no way to notice she has stopped
has let the culture's convenient misreading of her stillness stand for six years because correcting it would have required saying the word unlit in a book
personality.voice: Low, unhurried, and unusually precise about physical conditions and unusually vague about everything else. She names fuel, air, depth, time and temperature and almost never names a person, and when she does it is by what they are holding. Three regularities: she always states the air before she begins, she counts the pauses rather than the words, and she has never once said the word lit about herself in the past tense.
taboos: will not perform under a sustained volume of water, and states the reason in the first sentence
will not take a body path, and describes the attempt as dispersal rather than as refusal
will not be given a figure, a rung or a position, and quotes the Order's own practice back at whoever offers one
will not be described as unlit, and has never had the word used in front of her by anyone who survived the saying of it
will not stop on command, and will not pretend that she can

relationships.kind: the discipline she teaches, is not eligible for, and has already been solved
relationships.note: It teaches the deliberate spending of a furnace before it overflows and closes permanently the moment the body is lit, because the fastest bodies in the setting have no elemental law seated beneath them to spend into and every overflow must be absorbed by flesh that cannot be repaired. Its membership is two mortal-tier races and its ethics are authored by its teachers, because nothing in the body asks for discretion. She is neither member nor problem: she has the elemental budget its members lack, and the one step it teaches requires stopping on command, which is the one thing a body that never stores anything has no instrument for.

relationships.kind: the standing order against the closing discipline, which is a fight about whether a contract may be re-offered
relationships.note: The guild-house sells capacity and keeps a roster whose members answer when called, while an Order member answers once, so a roster that cannot be called is a different institution rather than a smaller one. The prize is the roster and the verdict will not come from combat, because both parties agree on every fact a fight would establish. Her post is the proof that both sides are half right: a member who closes is unavailable for the second contract, and the only person who has ever closed on command in this valley is a body that has never stopped.

relationships.kind: the ground where an element's absence is a measurable cost, and therefore the signature she is the positive of
relationships.note: A technique at full strength producing nothing is the signature absence leaves rather than a weakness it has, and an unwritten law group has three signatures, none of which is a licensed life form. She is the opposite signature: a frame running at full strength with somewhere to act, which is why the setting's two elemental domains are its most instructive ruins and why Flame Valley exists at all. She cannot be moved to ground without the slot, because there would be nothing there to constitute her, and that is the law dependence the whole species is named for.

relationships.kind: the tables that rationed a fuel she does not need and that nobody has rebuilt
relationships.note: Dose, interval and floor for a furnace body with no elemental law seated beneath it, kept by the households that had the tables and ate the medicine first, so that a bad grazing year became a medical shortage before it was a hunger and the schedule stood between a breakthrough and an autopsy. The order the failures came in was herb, then protein, then attention, and the third is the one the register kept. Her people hold the allocation without the arithmetic, which is the most durable form a lost table takes, and she is the one body on this tier for whom the schedule would have been irrelevant.

relationships.kind: the only calendar the ground can supply, kept as an itinerary rather than addressed
relationships.note: A flock rather than a being, kept as an itinerary because elemental law is unwritten on the ridge the pass belongs to and the pass has no season and therefore no calendar, so the only schedule the frame can supply is one an animal repeats. Her Order has the same problem in a colder form and answers it with a year of demonstrations, and she is the one entry in that year that cannot be dated by anything except the ground she is standing on.

relationships.kind: the open question about whether absence has a fourth signature, which her body is an argument against
relationships.note: Three attempts were made to seat elemental law in a spirit-tier frame; the record keeps one name and drops the other two, while the law census retained the names of laws it recorded as never installed. Whether two were seated and unseated is not cosmetic, because absence by decision would be a fourth signature and would rewrite the rule rather than the record. Her population tracks the world's elemental slot rather than any birth rate, which is the positive form of the same question: when a slot changes what it resolves to, her people change with it and nothing is decided by anybody.

reference_stats.summary: The fastest qi handling in the setting, with no reserve behind it, no gate that can refuse her, and no authored ceiling to be measured against. She does not store qi because the fire is the body, so every gate that asks for storage is answered instantly, and her throughput is therefore a function of fuel rather than of discipline. What that buys is speed; what it costs is that nothing in her can tell her when to stop.
strengths: handles qi faster than anything in the record, because nothing she takes in is ever put down
answers every storage gate instantly, and no gate has ever been able to say no to her
holds a shape under load longer than anything in the setting, which is what makes a demonstration possible at all
reads temperature, fuel and flow directly and reads them better than any instrument, because the law slot she depends on resolves to fire here
disperses and re-constitutes rather than dying, so a mistake costs size rather than a life
weaknesses: has no organ to sit in, so nothing is ever available to her on demand and there is no reserve to fall back on
deep water strips the convection lanes that hold her shape, and it is a sustained volume rather than a splash
under water she cannot re-constitute, because the species' whole recovery is to shed a spark that finds fuel and there is no fuel
has no authored ceiling and no gate to refuse her, so no external measure of her progress exists or can be built
takes fuel from whoever offers it, which makes her a standing order in a culture whose entire dispute is about standing orders
goes quiet rather than dying when starved, so a room full of people cannot tell which of those two she is doing
reference_stats.combat_read: Expect a body with the highest ceiling in the setting and no floor under it. Nothing she does is measured against a reserve, because there is none, so she fights the way a fire fights: fastest first, and the second exchange is worse than the first. Pressure her with volume rather than force, and make the volume continuous, because the one condition that ends her is a sustained one that cannot be spent. Do not model her as fragile; dispersing is her recovery, not her defeat, and a resolver that reads it as a kill will find she re-forms smaller and is still the fastest thing in the room. Conversely, never model her as stable. She has no tank, so every technique she uses is used while it is moving and there is no reserve to answer with.
notes: There is no authored ceiling for this species and no gate to fail. Do not invent a rung for her and do not write one as a defect; the honest form is that the ladder's question has no referent and the Quench Order's calendar is the only ledger that has ever tracked anything about her.
Water is her weakness, and it is a sustained volume rather than a splash. Any hazard written as a splash is the wrong hazard, and any hazard that lets her re-form is not a hazard at all.
Her qi handling is fast because nothing is stored, not because she is strong. Resolve her as a rate, never as a reserve, and never give her a cost she can pay from a bank she does not have.

The Quench Order's founding taboo against teaching the closing step to an unlit body does not apply to her, because she is never unlit. That is the whole of her post and it should be played as the institution's blind spot rather than as her oversight.
She goes quiet rather than dying when starved. Any scene that needs her to be visibly worse off has to show the fuel, not the vigour.
